title: 8 Ordinary Jobs God Used to Build Men in Scripture
caption:
8 ordinary jobs God used to build men in Scripture.

Moses with sheep, David with sheep, Joseph in a prison, Nehemiah as a cupbearer, Daniel in a government office, Peter with nets, Paul with tents, and Jesus with a saw.

Your boring Tuesday might be the workshop.
